title: celmisia verbascifolia subsp. membranacea
intro: Celmisia verbascifolia subsp. membranacea, commonly known as Snowy Tree Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Snowy Tree Daisy include its ability to calm and relax the nervous system, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
